purpose: Batch 20 official company, school, planning-policy, neighbourhood-plan, canal, flood and transactional-diligence sources. Context and route sources do not establish ownership, value, permission, lease, possession or exact parcel geometry.

sources.coverage: Official company identity, status and registered-office address at Unit 4 Hermes Close, Hermes Court, CV34 6NJ
sources.binding_limit: The record corroborates a company-address relationship only. It does not prove occupation, ownership, vacant possession, seller authority, title extent or building compliance.

sources.coverage: Official filing history showing former registered-office users changing away from Seton House in 2025 and May 2026
sources.binding_limit: Registered-office changes are occupancy-history context only. They do not prove physical occupation, lease surrender, ownership, vacant possession, seller authority or title extent.

sources.coverage: Official planning, enforcement, land-charges and building-control entry route for 16-18 High Street and Wolvey land
sources.binding_limit: No candidate-specific application, decision, approved plan, land-charge result or building-control certificate was opened.

sources.coverage: Official town-centre frontage and regeneration context expressly covering High Street and conservation-area design work

sources.coverage: Official adopted Wolvey Neighbourhood Development Plan forming part of the development plan since May 2022
sources.binding_limit: The plan is adopted policy context, but no exact marketed-title boundary or site-policy join was completed for the Leicester Road land.

sources.binding_limit: The source corroborates an emerging-plan site identity only. The emerging plan is not adopted and does not constitute planning permission or prove the marketed title extent.

sources.coverage: Official establishment record for Skilts School, URN 103617, Gorcott Hill, Beoley, B98 9ET, closed 31 August 2021

sources.binding_limit: The records corroborate former public use and relocation. They do not establish present ownership, title, disposal authority, legal-pack accuracy or development permission.

sources.coverage: Official statutory-consultee role for qualifying development affecting canals and associated waterway infrastructure
sources.binding_limit: The guidance establishes consultation context only. No Navigation Inn site application, consultation response, ownership, access right or consent was identified.

sources.binding_limit: The service provides area-level modelled indicators and expressly does not determine whether an individual property will flood. Candidate-specific map results were not captured.

sources.binding_limit: No exact Navigation Inn land red-line was overlaid on the adopted map. The Lapworth neighbourhood plan is not progressed and supplies no adopted site allocation.
